# PRC trained with a second sheet (Scenario 1), evaluated on the Hackathon sheet only

*Generated by `scripts/finish_mix.sh` (Slurm). Training: the PRC weights fine-tuned on the 3 training folds of the Hackathon sheet plus every block of Scenario 1 (`examples/otherdata`, half of the training tiles). Evaluation: the held-out fold of the Hackathon sheet (out of fold, the same folds as before), then routes, the 10 exercises and the mismatch analysis on the `examples` data only. Scenario 1 is never used for evaluation.*
